title: Extraction started
detail: Single lane (UK). patchright punches through Imperva where curl, Firecrawl and plain Playwright all failed.

title: Rate-block hit (~497)
detail: Home IP tripped Imperva’s per-IP limit (~450 requests in ~25 min). Got challenges instead of pages — paused to cool down.

title: CAPTCHA solved → resumed
detail: NordVPN datacenter IP fails automated, but a human-solved CAPTCHA clears it. Resumed scraping on the VPN IP. (~approx)

title: Live dashboard up
detail: This page (1.6x7.gr) went live, auto-refreshing every 5 min.

title: Scaled to 6 lanes
detail: 6 parallel browsers, each on a different Nord SOCKS5 exit IP. Solved 6 CAPTCHAs. ~6× throughput.

title: Scaled to 9 lanes
detail: Nord’s max distinct exits (9). ~9× throughput, full run projected ~6h.

title: Slowdown / possible block
detail: Smyths: failures rising fast — now 1872 (was 124), 1541/58650 done. Possible block.
